description: Higgsfield AI image and video generation CLI — drive both the documented platform API and the cloud web backend from one tool, with local memory across generations, Soul IDs, and credits.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Show signed-in account email, plan, and available credits. Returns the Account.

tools.name: account_transactions
tools.description: List recent credit transactions (debits for generations, credits for top-ups/refunds). Optional: size (default: 50). Returns array of Transaction.

params.name: size
params.description: Maximum number of transactions to return

tools.name: generations_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a pending Higgsfield generation job before it completes. Required: request_id (path) — the generation/job ID returned when the generation was submitted (UUID format). Returns the job's final state with status set to canceled. Use this when a long-running video or image job is no longer needed; cancellation may not be possible once a job has reached a terminal state (succeeded, failed). Prefer over deleting via the local store, which only forgets the job locally without freeing remote compute.

tools.name: generations_get
tools.description: Get one generation by ID (web backend). Required: request_id. Returns the Generation.

tools.name: generations_list
tools.description: List recent generation jobs from the web backend (cloud.higgsfield.ai). Returns the most-recent 100 by default. Optional: size (default: 100), type.

params.name: size
params.description: Maximum number of jobs to return (1-100)

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by job type: image, video, or text

tools.name: models_get
tools.description: Get one model's full parameter schema. Required: model_id. Returns the Model.

tools.name: models_list
tools.description: List all available models with type, display name, and backend assignment. Optional: type. Returns array of Model.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by type: image, video, or text

tools.name: soul_ids_create
tools.description: Train a new Soul ID from at least 5 reference images. Returns the new Soul ID's training job — poll with `soul-id wait`. Required: name, images. Optional: soul_2 (default: true).

params.name: name
params.description: Display name for the Soul ID (e.g. 'Riggs', 'StudioGoldenHour')

params.name: soul_2
params.description: Train as a Soul 2 reference (current generation; recommended)

tools.name: soul_ids_get
tools.description: Get one Soul ID and its training status. Required: soul_id. Returns the SoulID.

tools.name: soul_ids_list
tools.description: List all your Soul IDs (custom-trained character references). Optional: size (default: 100). Returns array of SoulID.

params.name: size
params.description: Maximum number of Soul IDs to return

tools.name: uploads_init
tools.description: Initialize a media upload — returns a media_id for the second step. Required: content_type. Optional: filename.

params.name: content_type
params.description: MIME type of the media being uploaded (e.g. image/png, image/jpeg, video/mp4)

tools.name: workspaces_list
tools.description: List workspaces available to your account. Returns array of Workspace.

tools.name: workspaces_status
tools.description: Show the currently selected workspace. Returns the Workspace.
